description: US epoxy brand selling deep-pour and bar/table-top epoxy resins, colorants, tools and accessories for river tables, countertops and resin art, sold direct through WiseBond.com. evidence.summary: Official WiseBond affiliate page fetched in full: 'Refer your followers! Earn a 10% cash commission!' Affiliates get a personal discount code (followers save 10%), an Affiliate Dashboard with live tracking, and are paid 10% of referral purchases by cash check once they hit $150. The page answers the earnings-cap question directly: 'Is there a cap on earnings? No way' — and its FAQ (updated October 15, 2026) repeats 'No earnings cap: There's no limit on how much commission you can earn' and 'You earn 10% of every qualifying purchase made with your code or link, with no cap on total earnings.' The explicit no-cap statements on the brand's own page make the commission cap UNCAPPED.

The same official page is written for creators: 'If you are an artist, creative studio, designer, wood worker, with your own personal or business social media platform, the WiseBond.com affiliate program is for you. We are seeking influencers to partner with us in creating unique and informative content.' It encourages posting the code across Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook groups and forums, and publishes info@wisebond.com for affiliate payment questions.
